NotebookLM generated the material on this page from the workshop's own sources.
No person wrote it and no person checked it. Use it as a *second pass* over
material you have already seen. Where it disagrees with the
[handbook](tensors_workshop_plan_with_quizzes.md), the handbook is right.
Generated {{< var companion.exported >}}.

Some artifacts are exported, and this site serves them: no account, no sign-in.
The rest are links into NotebookLM, which asks for a Google account. Each card
says which one it is.
